business_case: Late supplier payments cost us discounts and goodwill.

metric_definitions.name: late_payment_rate
metric_definitions.meaning: the share of supplier invoices paid more than 30 days after the invoice date

baseline_estimate: One metric: late payment rate, in %, meaning the share of supplier invoices paid more than 30 days after the invoice date. It is about 23% today, from the AP ledger for January to June 2026. It feeds our finance KPI, creditor days.
target_value: Late payment rate: under 5% of supplier invoices.
